description: Repository navigation inventory for agentic code discovery.

entries..zed/: Project-level Zed editor settings, including oxfmt formatter integration.
entries.package.json: Project metadata, dependencies, and package scripts.
entries.public/: Static application assets and installable-app icons.
entries.src/main.tsx: React application bootstrap and root mount.
entries.src/app/: Top-level application state, screen switching, and shell layout.
entries.src/components/BottomSheet/: Reusable accessible bottom-sheet dialog component and styles.
entries.src/components/MetronomeSoundSheet/: Reusable auto-committing Metronome sound selection sheet.
entries.src/components/ProgressSegments/: Segmented session-progress indicator component and styles.
entries.src/components/TimerRing/: Circular timer display component and styles.
entries.src/components/index.ts: Public barrel exports for shared components.
entries.src/config/: Typed practice settings, source YAML configuration, and tests.
entries.src/domain/: Routine, exercise, break, session, and validation domain logic.
entries.src/features/routine-editor/: Routine editor feature, including hooks, forms, components, styles, and tests.
entries.src/features/routine-editor/EditorSheet/: Bottom-sheet forms for routine names and routine entries.
entries.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineEdito: Routine editor feature composition and public props.
entries.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineEntry: Single routine-entry summary, edit, and delete controls.
Ordered list of editable routine entries.
entries.src/features/routine-editor/RoutineSetti: Quick Rest, warning, and Metronome sound settings UI.
entries.src/features/session-player/: Session player feature, including lifecycle, controls, timer views, styles, and tests.
entries.src/features/session-player/NowPlayingSh: Read-only session-step list shown in the Now Playing sheet.
entries.src/features/session-player/SessionContr: Playback, rewind, stop, and finish/skip controls.
entries.src/features/session-player/SessionIllus: Illustrations for exercise, break, and Quick Rest timer states.
entries.src/features/session-player/SessionPlaye: Session-player feature composition and public props.
entries.src/features/session-player/SessionTimer: Timer Ring content, tempo controls, and session illustration selection.
entries.src/services/audio/: Web Audio scheduling, playback cues, interfaces, and tests.
entries.src/services/persistence/: Browser-storage routine persistence and debounced saving.
entries.src/services/platform/: Browser platform lifecycle and wake-lock integrations.
entries.src/services/session/: Session planning, progression, timing, reducer logic, and tests.
entries.src/test/: Vitest and Testing Library test-environment setup.
entries.tsconfig.app.json: TypeScript configuration for browser application code.
entries.tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript configuration for Vite and Node-side configuration.
entries.vite.config.ts: Vite, React, PWA, and test-runner configuration.
entries.docs/: Project plans, implementation reports, ubiquitous language, and this inventory.
entries.docs/2026-08-08-timer-ring-children-impl: Implementation report for the TimerRing children API refactor.
